peg.peg_mechanism_score_basis: USDe held a tight 30-day Chainlink range of -7.79 to +0.22 bps with no -50 bps breach and has demonstrated resilience through the October 2025 outflow. Its primary peg loop is effective but permissioned and RFQ-based: 611 benefactors and 20 minter and redeemer role holders were live, while realized USDC orders priced near zero cost.
peg.peg_mechanism_score_persistence: Recheck after a material peg event or primary-rail policy change.

backing.backing_score_basis: The September 27 attestation reconciled $4.953bn of backing against $4.949bn supply plus a $62.095m Reserve Fund. The October 11 live feed measured 99.4781% before and 100.7690% after the fund. Custodians are named, but current look-through into institutional loans, individual RWAs and derivatives notional remains incomplete; CEX delta-hedge collateral was 20.39% of backing.
backing.backing_score_persistence: Recheck with each monthly attestation and any Reserve Fund policy change.

liquidity.liquidity_score_basis: The permissioned institutional mint and redemption rail is active, with median realized USDC mint and redeem spreads of +0.03 and -0.09 bps. The Ethereum USDe-to-USDC route cleared the full tested $5m inside 50 bps, so $5m is a floor rather than a located limit. Other-chain venue inventories are not treated as executable depth.
liquidity.liquidity_score_persistence: Recheck when the Ethereum crossing is located or chain-local ladders are added.

dependencies.underlying_score_basis: USDe depends on named stablecoin settlement assets, institutional custodians and borrowers, tokenization platforms, off-exchange providers and CEX venues. The set is credible but overlaps across roles and is only partly substitutable. The September attestation refreshed custody totals without providing complete asset-level exposure weights.
dependencies.underlying_score_persistence: Recheck when a full asset-level portfolio or counterparty concentration table is published.

issuer.issuer_score_basis: Ethena has a public team, institutional partners, repeated attestations, mature external monitoring and a demonstrated response to the October 2025 stress event. The offset is concentrated ENA governance: a fee-switch vote replaced the earlier Reserve-Fund-first policy, USDe holders do not vote, and one voter could clear quorum alone. The switch remains dormant below the $7.5bn supply milestone.
issuer.issuer_score_persistence: Recheck at fee-switch activation, a governance redesign or a material operational failure.
